subject: reasoning
question: Choose the group in which all numbers belong to the same category:
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Numbers which are divisible by 2 (Even numbers).

Now, checking the options:

**Option 1) 2, 4, 6, 8**

⇒ 2 is divisible by 2

⇒ 4 is divisible by 2

⇒ 6 is divisible by 2

⇒ 8 is divisible by 2

(All numbers are even numbers.)

Option 2) 3, 6, 9, 11

⇒ 3 is not divisible by 2

⇒ 6 is divisible by 2

⇒ 9 is not divisible by 2

⇒ 11 is not divisible by 2

(Not all are even.)

Option 3) 5, 10, 13, 21

⇒ 5 is not divisible by 2

⇒ 10 is divisible by 2

⇒ 13 is not divisible by 2

⇒ 21 is not divisible by 2

(Not all are even.)

Option 4) 7, 14, 26, 38

⇒ 7 is not divisible by 2

⇒ 14 is divisible by 2

⇒ 26 is divisible by 2

⇒ 38 is divisible by 2

(Not all are even.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
